newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks down in thin morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks down in thin morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks fell on Monday morning, the last day of the 1996/97 business year. Brokers said the Nikkei was down near the psychologically important 18,000 level, but losses were exaggerated by the thin trade.
By 0016 GMT, the 225-shares Nikkei average had slipped 158.62 points or 0.87 percent to 18,031.10. Its June futures were 150 points lower at 18,060.

Brokers said foreign investors were off for the Easter holiday and dealers were reluctant to move on the last day of the current business year, but bargain-hunting would appear should the index fall below 18,000.
